topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: Mornin', neighbor. Found a box, did ye? Buried long ago, you say? Well, that’s odd, indeed. Ain’t recollectin’ no one speakin’ of such a thing. Think it could be some sort of sign, perhaps from the saints themselves? Or mayhaps some wayfarer from a distant village left it, seekin’ a reminder of home. Whatever it is, best to tread carefully. Best to speak to the elder, see what he makes of it. He’s seen more than a few harvests and might know somethin’. Don’t you go openin’ it just yet. Wait till we’ve had a proper think. Wouldn’t want to upset the spirits or bring down a curse on our crops, now would we?
